CS 135 — Designing Functional Programs
Semester: 1A

Grading:
- Assignments: 30%
- Midterm Exam: 25%
- Final Exam: 45%

Required tools: Racket (DrRacket IDE), course notes (free PDF on course site).

Policies:
- Late work: 10% deducted per day late, up to 3 days, after which a 0 is given.
- Academic integrity: All work must be your own; violations are referred to the Associate Dean.
- Regrade requests must be submitted within 7 days of grades being posted.

Key Dates:
- Assignment 1 due September 20, 2026 (no specific time given).
- Assignment 2 due September 27, 2026 at 11:59 PM.
- Midterm Exam on October 15, 2026 at 2:00 PM.
- Final Exam during the exam period (date TBA).

Weekly Schedule:
- Week 1 (Sept 8): Introduction to Racket, basic recursion. Lecture meets Mondays at 10:00 AM.
- Week 2 (Sept 15): Structural recursion on lists.
- Week 3 (Sept 22): Trees and mutual recursion.
